desc: The THOR Kitchen 24 Inch Professional Electric Range is a stainless-steel machine that is designed with powerful features and functionality. This range features a smooth glass top that is easy to clean and four heating element zones that give you the ultimate cooking flexibility.
hl: Easy to fit in a 24-Inch space, this freestanding professional electric range features a frameless glass top that is flush with the countertop giving it a seamless look that is easy to clean
Four element cooktop gives you the ultimate cooking flexibility with a powerful radiant cooktop.
The true convection fan blows heat from the 800W heating element for more even heating and optimum cooking and baking results
spec: Front Right Corner of Cooktop w/ Temp at 150 °F
Bake, Broil, Keep Warm, Convection Bake, Convection Roast
